scope: Two approved themes, separately generated source layers for uGUI. No baked text or gameplay art changes.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster game UI sprite, ONE independent layer only. Reference image is the approved DeepSeek dialog STYLE REFERENCE. Produce ONLY a blank button's filled inner BASE PLATE, not the entire dialog, not a screenshot, not the decorative frame. calm deep ocean blue glass/enamel, faint azure inner reflections, delicate water-current shading, hand-painted anime UI finish. Flat straight-on orthographic 2D. Wide horizontal softly rounded rectangular plate with straight parallel top and bottom edges and rounded corners, NOT a stretched oval. Roughly 4:1 visible shape, centered in a 1536x1024 transparent canvas, visible rectangle approximately x128..1408 and y352..672. The filled interior is calm, near-opaque, low contrast, with continuous quiet gradients and extremely subtle texture suitable for 9-slice stretching. NO frame, NO bright border, NO trim, NO ornament, NO text, NO buttons within the plate, NO symbols, NO stars, NO cast shadow. Clean antialiased edge. Every pixel outside this one plate genuinely transparent; no backdrop, no fake checkerboard. This base will be stacked under separately generated frame and ornament layers in Unity uGUI; do not bake those layers into it.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster game UI sprite, ONE independent small ornamental emblem. Reference is approved DeepSeek UI STYLE ONLY; do not reproduce its dialog or buttons.
